mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned picture connects muscle compression, valve closure and forward flow in a concrete mechanism.

leastWorthwhile.text: The capillary-bed result was rather brief: it described a fine web but did not carry the initial picture’s endothelial and support-layer detail into the result.

surprise.text: The venous-valve result added contracting limb muscle, making clear how compression can assist return rather than leaving the valves to explain flow on their own.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless. The capillary support-sleeve picture used the term 'pericytes' without explaining it, though their depicted position helped with the lining choice.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing how this vessel network connects to further physiology; the branching and valve constructions made structure and function easy to relate.
